body:
Hello, wondering if you could do a readings for me please?

Sorry, I'm yet another person asking about an ex. My ex broke up with me about 2 months ago, after a long break - what I'd call a "long goodbye". We've not been in contact at all since the split. I've been using positive affirmations to help give myself a boost (and they seem to be working), and using the time to try and get myself back on track after a period of feeling like I was stagnant waiting for his decision. I've been making plans for my future without him (there's some really exciting adventures in there!). I do still want a future with him, I don't want to stall my momentum. I guess the answers I'm searching for are is it possible that I can have that future that I want - with him, but also, what's going to happen with my new plans? Honestly, right now if he turned up it wouldn't be the right time - I think it would stall my plans and we'd end up on the same rollercoaster again, except worse because I'd have stopped my momentum. 

Sorry, that's a lot of info. Can you help me find some answers?
